must: Use the existing semantic color and radius tokens
Keep controls keyboard accessible with visible focus
Preserve responsive layouts and reduced-motion behavior

decisions: Authentication uses a restrained split layout and the protected workspace uses a compact capability-driven sidebar.
The login access selector uses a minimal centered card over a near-black, blue binary rain background with reduced-motion support.
Authenticated dashboard and cases pages use a fixed-by-default, user-customizable widget grid with restrained inline layout controls and existing semantic tokens.
The network workspace reserves its dominant canvas for Cytoscape interactions; only surrounding evidence and detail panels use the customizable workspace grid.
The network graph uses compact marker-style SVG nodes, selective semantic labels, and small hover cards; relationship evidence remains in the authorized side panels rather than the canvas.

The geographic network view uses a defensively darkened OpenFreeMap Liberty baselayer, preserves useful roads, water, and place labels, and keeps bright authorized intelligence overlays visually dominant.
Incident and timeline workspaces retain the compact fixed-by-default investigation layout: chronology is dense but readable, with type filters and source links instead of decorative temporal effects.

The authenticated shell stays compact by default, expands on hover or keyboard focus, and uses role-filtered real routes; the dashboard uses calm authorized module focus states instead of a full-screen scroll experience.

Global search, administration, and audit views use dense bounded lists with quiet metadata, responsive row-to-card transitions, and explicit restricted-state copy rather than command-palette theatrics.

Reports use a calm two-column generator/history console and a print-safe document surface: authoritative records, investigative leads, dismissed leads, and source provenance stay visibly separated with compact structured metadata.
